profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 250 m, Orchard MRT about 820 m; closer than 452 of 551 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 600 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 570 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 400 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,390 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 760 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 810 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 890 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,260 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,430 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,470 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,500 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,680 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 479 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 157 new sales and 1,225 resales (1,382 purchases); new sales were 11.4% of these purchases. Subsales (58) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,225 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 468 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,225 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,287 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.8%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
